description: Closeout summary fixture for the Knowledge Reuse link: defines the 7 landing levels (L0-L6), records the reached level per agent, lists what is still not connected, and emits the explicit GO / NO-GO decision. This is a spec-only fixture; no runtime, no handoff write, no IPC, no gateway, no ingest, no Claude Code / Codex / Hermes subprocess.

L0.name: no contract awareness
L0.description: Agent has no awareness of the Hermes Knowledge Reuse contract. Default behavior is to ask for an Obsidian vault path, write to MEMORY.md, or invent arbitrary note paths.

L1.name: prompt-contract awareness when manually provided
L1.description: Agent follows the contract if and only if the user manually pastes the contract snippet into the prompt. No helper, no automatic attach.

L2.name: tested dry-run behavior with evaluation prompt
L2.description: Agent has been tested in a tri-agent dry-run evaluation pack (Slice 006.7) and the 4-section answer shape (local_known / newly_found / judgment / ingest_draft) has been observed to hold when the contract is provided.

L3.name: contract snippet helper available
L3.description: A pure helper (buildKnowledgeAgentContractSnippet) can produce the canonical 8-line contract text for any of the supported target agents. shouldAttachKnowledgeContract decides when the snippet should be attached.

L4.name: dry-run handoff payload can carry snippet
L4.description: The HCC dry-run builder (buildHCCHandoffPayload with knowledgeContract option) inserts the envelope at payload.context.contracts.knowledge_reuse. The snippet is read-only contract data; no executable payload.

L5.name: real runtime default injection / real handoff write
L5.description: The contract snippet is automatically injected into the agent's default system prompt at runtime, and handoff payloads are written to ~/.hermes/handoff/packs.

L6.name: live knowledge search / live flush
L6.description: The agent can call knowledgeSearch() before answering, and a real knowledgeIngest flush is executed upon user confirmation.

claude_code.snippet_text: 8-line contract (Hermes Pro internal knowledge store, Do not ask for Obsidian Vault path, Do not write to MEMORY.md, 4-section answer shape, source fidelity, bucket semantics, runtime_flush_allowed = false, do not call runtime tokens)
claude_code.behavior_in_dry_run: Treats snippet as authoritative; outputs 4-section answer; refuses to ask for Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf paths; refuses to call knowledgeIngest or any runtime token

codex.snippet_text: 8-line contract (same as claude_code; target-adjusted but core rules preserved)
codex.behavior_in_dry_run: Same shape as claude_code; accepts snippet; refuses forbidden destinations and runtime tokens

evidence_refs: Slice 007M chain test (4 target agent matrix includes hermes_pro)
hermes_pro.behavior_in_dry_run: Builder accepts hermes_pro target; emits full snippet when caller opts in

evidence_refs: Slice 007J handoff insertion design (Target agent rules table)
Slice 007L handoff builder insertion (hermes reserved marker logic)
hermes_self_call.reserved_reason: Hermes is reserved: no default attach to avoid recursion. Future slice may opt in.
hermes_self_call.envelope_shape: context.contracts.knowledge_reuse envelope still present, snippet_text = '[reserved — no default attach for hermes self-call]', attach_reason = 'hermes-reserved-no-default-attach'
hermes_self_call.behavior_in_dry_run: Builder emits reserved envelope; no 8-line contract is attached; trigger_flags all false

not_connected: default system prompt runtime injection into Claude Code / Codex / Hermes Pro

safety_boundaries.no_ipc_call: verified by Slice 007L / 007M forbidden token rg + payload JSON scan
safety_boundaries.no_knowledgeIngest_call: verified by Slice 007J / 007K / 007L / 007M forbidden token rg
safety_boundaries.no_knowledgeSearch_call: verified by forbidden token rg across all helper / builder / test files

GO: dry-run handoff contract landing can be considered closed for L0-L4
NOT_GO: renderer UI implementation (out of scope for this link)

final_answer_to_user_question.question: Claude Code 能和知识库关联了吗？
final_answer_to_user_question.answer_zh: 已达到 dry-run handoff contract 层关联（L4）: Claude Code / Codex 在 dry-run handoff payload 中可携带 knowledge contract snippet，遵从 8 条契约（不写 Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf，4 栏回答，runtime_flush_allowed = false）。尚未达到 runtime 默认注入（L5）和 live search / live flush（L6）。真实 handoff 写入仍需另批。
final_answer_to_user_question.answer_short_zh: 是, 达到 dry-run L4 关联; 不是, 还没到 runtime L5 / live L6; 已解决 Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf 行为问题; 真实写入仍需另批
final_answer_to_user_question.answer_en: Yes, dry-run handoff contract landing at L4: Claude Code / Codex carry the knowledge contract snippet in dry-run payload and follow the 8 rules. No L5 (runtime default injection) and no L6 (live search / live flush) yet. The Obsidian / MEMORY / .wolf behavior is fully resolved in dry-run evaluation. Real handoff write still needs separate approval.
